# A New Save Slot

#### Course: Practical Git and GitHub

## A New Save Slot

In many games, you can have multiple save slots. One is your main progress. Another is where you try something new without affecting what already works.

Git works in a similar way.

A branch is a separate path of work. You create one, make changes on it, and your main branch stays untouched.

A new branch always starts from your current position.

If the work goes well, you bring it back. If not, you can leave it without affecting your main work.
